title: Down To Mars' "Tell Me": A Refreshing R&B Classic
htmlContent:
Kentucky-bred duo Down To Mars has been making waves in the R&B and hip-hop scene, and their latest EP, "YOU," is a testament to their musical prowess. The EP's intro track, "Tell Me," stands out with its signature talkbox sound and catchy beat.

With over 4 million plays on their lead single, "The Loneliest Number," Down To Mars has cemented its place as a new force to be reckoned with in the music industry. Their unique blend of old and new influences is evident in "Tell Me," It sets the tone for the entire EP.

Malachi and Pinky, the duo behind Down To Mars, are inspired by musical greats like Jimi Hendrix, Earth Wind & Fire, and D'Angelo but also incorporate modern sounds to create something unique. They've already produced for viral sensation Zaza and other rising artists, and it's clear that their star is only set to climb higher.

Overall, "Tell Me" is an excellent example of what Down To Mars offers. With their refreshing sound and level of musicianship, they're definitely ones to watch in the R&B and hip-hop scene.
